title: closure-rule-system
description: A finite or countable set of closure rules whose admissible antecedent formulas are fixed by a closure-rule language; it generates the least closure operator that is inflationary, idempotent, and closed under firing every rule instantiation.

rules.description: the finite or countable set S of closure rules

language.description: the closure-rule language fixing which antecedent formulas are admissible, and thereby the regime-class of the generated operator

generated_closure_operator.description: cl^S, the least operator satisfying the three conditions, obtained as the pointwise meet of all qualifying operator families

inflationary.description: v <=_k cl^S_p(v) for every fiber p

idempotent.description: cl^S_p . cl^S_p = cl^S_p for every fiber p

rule_closed.description: for every rule r in S and every instantiation y of its free variables, the consequent of r[y] holds in cl^S(v) whenever its antecedent does
